title: WAL mode + max_connections(4) is correct for the read pattern
description: WAL mode allows concurrent readers while a writer holds the write lock, which matches the stoa read pattern (many NNTP readers, occasional article ingest). max_connections(4) is a reasonable pool size. A future contributor might suggest synchronous=FULL for durability; Normal is correct here — WAL provides crash safety and Normal avoids the fsync overhead that would hurt article ingest throughput.
